summary: Testing completed for Navigate import fix, Admin login, Admin Dashboard, and Dashboard API connections. Found CRITICAL bug: ReactQuill rich text editor crashes with React 19 due to deprecated findDOMNode API.

minor.issue: Fixed jwt.JWTError to jwt.exceptions.PyJWTError - PyJWT library compatibility

ui_bugs.issue: CRITICAL: ReactQuill crashes with 'TypeError: react_dom_1.default.findDOMNode is not a function' when opening Create Content modal. This is due to React 19 incompatibility - findDOMNode was deprecated in React 18 and removed in React 19.
ui_bugs.selector: ReactQuill component in Content Management form

navigate_import_fix.details: Frontend loads successfully without errors. Navigate import from react-router-dom is working correctly.

admin_login_flow.details: Admin login with admin@kangqore.com works correctly. Role selection -> credentials -> dashboard redirect all working.

admin_dashboard_user_management.details: User Management tab shows stats (Total Users: 5, Clients: 2, Partners: 0, Investors: 0, Job Seekers: 0), Pending Approvals section, and System Status panel.

admin_dashboard_content_management.details: Content Management tab loads and shows content list (1 Blog post). However, Create Content button crashes due to ReactQuill incompatibility with React 19.

backend_apis.details: All 18 backend API tests passed including auth, admin stats, admin users, content management, and role-based dashboard access control.

dashboard_api_connections.details: All 4 non-admin dashboards (Client, Partner, Investor, Job Seeker) are properly connected to backend APIs. They will show empty states since no data exists for these roles.

action_items: CRITICAL: Fix ReactQuill compatibility with React 19. Options: 1) Downgrade to React 18, 2) Replace ReactQuill with a React 19 compatible editor like @tiptap/react, Lexical, or Slate, 3) Use a simple textarea as fallback
Consider adding seed data for testing non-admin dashboards (Client, Partner, Investor, Job Seeker)
critical_code_review_comments: react-quill 2.0.0 is NOT compatible with React 19 - uses deprecated findDOMNode API
ESLint warnings about missing useEffect dependencies in all dashboard components - should add eslint-disable comments or fix dependencies
